TEMPORAL_CHANGE_MAP.split_note: LEVIR-CD official test split, 2048 tiles, 1024 pixels sampled per tile, checkpoint best.pt. Split for fitting is by TILE, not by pixel, because pixels within a tile are spatially correlated and a pixel-wise split would leak. The head was trained with pos_weight=10.1, so its logits carry a deliberate positive-class offset that temperature scaling alone cannot remove.

note: Heads under `rejected` are deliberately left uncalibrated at runtime and keep reporting ece_after = -1.0. A fitted parameter that did not survive its own held-out check is worse than none.
